mapper.sql: id, type_id, item_code, item_name, sort_order, is_default, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dictionary_item WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.id, i.type_id, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.sort_order, i.is_default, i.status, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM sys_dictionary_item i INNER JOIN sys_dictionary_type t ON t.id = i.type_id WHERE t.type_code = #{typeCode} AND t.status = 'ENABLED' AND i.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY i.sort_order ASC, i.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dictionary_item SET is_default = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND is_default = 1

UPDATE sys_dictionary_item SET item_name = #{dictionaryItem.name}, sort_order = #{dictionaryItem.sortOrder}, is_default = #{dictionaryItem.defaultItem}, status = #{dictionaryItem.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{dictionaryItem.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dictionary_item ( id, type_id, item_code, item_name, sort_order, is_default, status ) VALUES ( #{dictionaryItem.id}, #{dictionaryItem.typeId}, #{dictionaryItem.code}, #{dictionaryItem.name}, #{dictionaryItem.sortOrder}, #{dictionaryItem.defaultItem}, #{dictionaryItem.status} )
